sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE BINOD KUMAR DWIVEDI  ON THE 11 th OF JUNE, 2024

BETWEEN:-
 NARAYANSINGH S/O RAMSWAROOPJI SONDHIYA,
 AGED 37 YEARS, OCCUPATION: LABOUR R/O GRAM  DABI TEHSIL AND DISTRICT BUNDI (RAJASTHAN)

(BY SHRI PRADEEP KUMAR LALWANI - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION JEERAN DISTRICT NEEMUCH (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 .....RES  (BY SHRI S.K. BHATI - PANEL LAWYER)

This application coming on for admission this day, the co  following:
 ORDER

This is first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed by the applicant/accused relating to FIR/Crime No.94/2019 registered at Police Station - Jeeran, District Neemuch for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 365, 366 and 376(2) of IPC.
2.
It is a case of bail jump.
3. Earlier, applicant was granted bail by this Court.

Thereafter, he failed to appear before the Trial Court on 19.07.2021 therefore, Trial Court had issued warrant of arrest on 21.02.2022 and he was arrested on 03.03.2024 and produced before the Trial Court and is in custody since then therefore,
prays 2 MCRC-22781-2024 that this application for grant of bail be allowed and he be released on bail.
4.
Learned Government Advocate for the State has objected the prayer and prayed for its rejection.

5. On due consideration of the aforesaid and looking to the period of custody of the applicant,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I allow the bail application and direct that the applicant - Narayansingh shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing a personal bond in the sum o f Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with solvent surety t o the satisfaction of the Narayansingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184931989/
1

6. A copy of this order be sent to the Court concerned for its compliance.
7. The bail application is allowed and stands disposed of.
